mostWorthwhile.text: Building the inner wall was most worthwhile: it connected water recovery with the surprising use of molecules made by bacteria.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus was clear but uneventful; the result was just what I expected.

surprise.text: I was surprised that bacteria produce gas as well as small fatty acids, and that some of those molecules can fuel lining cells.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary. The last two combinations were the only available actions, but their purposes were clear from the pictures and goals.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the connection between microbes and the colon lining made me curious, even though the later fittings were predictable.
